excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK RECTANGULAR lens glasses, a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jean slacks and black dress shoes.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1, wearing his signature black rectangular glasses, looks through a magnifying visor to clear compacted, brittle ash grey volcanic tuff matrix from the hyper-elongated neck of a small Hyphalosaurus skeleton. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
